author: Tynvale
body:
I recently went on to the MapDev server to test out a voting system set up by IcyCode and it worked really well.
What's your opinions? Do you think it should be added? What are some pros and cons?

title: [SUG] In-Game Map Voting

replies.author: Legoche
replies.body: It would be good, but everybody would vote for popular maps, like Quintus, which isn't good for gameplay.
replies.body_tagged: It would be good, but everybody would vote for popular maps, like Quintus, which isn't good for gameplay.

replies.author: IcyCode
replies.body:
Let me explain what happens here...

Basically I have setup the server like in SG so when you join you go into a waiting lobby where you can vote for what map you want to play next using the map voting GUI. When the player count is high enough a countdown begins and when it reaches 0 all players are moved to the map where the chosen map (highest voted) is played as normal. When the match finishes it goes back to the lobby and this starts over again.

For those of you wondering how on earth I managed to do this take a look at my Pull Request here: https://github.com/Avicus/Rotations/pull/10.

It's currently on the MapDev server so feel free to take a look ;D
